title: Rendering Issue when layering subviewports and setting Transparent Background
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.4.stable.arch_linux
This also appeared in v4.3.stable.arch_linux at least sind January 15. 2025

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 ZEN SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 27 Feb 2025 18:09:27 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (RADV NAVI23) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

I am using layered Subviewports in my project. The world viewport contains the traversable world while the second one displays a background. For this to work i set the main viewport to have transparent background. When using additive shaders in this viewport they get a blackbox artifact where the transparency should be. This occurs in the editor as well when setting the editor viewport to transparent. The issue results in nothing from the background viewport being shown in the affected region. When the material is overlapping objects from the main viewport, the overlapping parts are not affected.
Additionally enabling FSR 2.2 and/or TAA leads to the world viewport no longer having a transparent background.
One note: Using a texture that uses true alpha and setting transparency to alpha in the material does not produce these artifacts.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Load the provided demo project
2. Look at the main scene there should already be artifacts ( SubViewport2 is the world while SubViewport is the background)
3. Start the game and the artifacts should still be there
4. Enable TAA and/or FSR 2.2 and start the game. The world should no longer have a transparent background.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ViewportRenderingIssue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19108343/ViewportRenderingIssue.zip)
